title: Documentation support (MEAT) for chronic conditions
question: Which chronic condition, if any, is supported for risk adjustment by this note? Ignore the reason for the visit. Choose 'no code' if none is supported.
note:
Chief Complaint: Follow-up for heart failure.

HPI: The patient presents today for a scheduled follow-up regarding chronic systolic heart failure. The patient reports feeling well today and denies any recent episodes of shortness of breath, increased swelling in the lower extremities, or significant fatigue. They report adherence to their current medication regimen and state that their weight has remained consistent.

Medication List: Lisinopril, Carvedilol, Furosemide.

Exam: The patient appears in no acute distress. Vital signs are stable. Heart sounds are regular with no murmurs noted. Lungs are clear to auscultation bilaterally. No peripheral edema is observed in the lower extremities.

Assessment: 
1. Chronic systolic heart failure: The patient is currently stable and reports good symptom management.

Plan: 
1. Chronic systolic heart failure: The plan is to continue the current medication regimen. The patient was instructed to monitor for any sudden weight gain and will follow up in three months.
explanations: The provider addressed chronic systolic heart failure at this visit, so it is supported: I50.22.

distractors.why: Status plus a plan in the assessment supports the diagnosis.
